ADMF 102 - Technology in Advanced Manufacturing

CREDIT HOURS MIN: 3

LECTURE HOURS MIN: 2

LAB HOURS MIN: 2

Introduces manufacturing processes and the basic mechanical, electrical and fluid power systems a technician maintains on a production line.

This description is published by the college for the current catalog and is reviewed each year by the academic department that offers it. Students should speak with an advisor before registering, since availability varies by term and by campus. The wording below is used for the print edition and the web edition alike, so the two stay identical.
